title: Tourist Season, 2020
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Overrun. A tourist on Wood's stool. He draws her from the door. She's reading the strip on her phone on his stool and doesn't know.

panels.composition: Gully's, packed. A TOURIST on the end stool reading the strip on her phone. WOOD in the doorway with BARNABY II, looking at his stool.

image.prompt: a packed bait-and-espresso shop with a tourist on the end stool reading a comic on her phone, a thin man in the doorway with a three-legged dog looking at the stool, a man in an apron working frantically, clean ink

panels.composition: Her phone: the strip. The stool she's on, in the strip, with Wood on it.

image.prompt: close-up of a phone screen showing a comic panel of a thin man on a shop stool, held by someone sitting on that stool

panels.composition: Wood, from the door, drawing her on his stool.

image.prompt: a thin man in a shop doorway drawing a tourist who sits on a stool reading her phone, unaware

panels.composition: Wood leaving. The dock. The pup. Gully's voice from inside, over the crowd, one word. Wood raises a hand without turning.

image.prompt: a thin man walking out onto a dock with a three-legged dog raising one hand without turning back toward a crowded shop, no words

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust

notes: She's on his stool reading him. He draws her from the door.
